notablePrerequisites:
Catapult Captain does not have summoning sickness.
You have a higher life total than an opponent.
description:
Activate Catapult Captain by paying {2}{B}, tapping it, and sacrificing Angelic Enforcer, causing target opponent with a lower life total than you to lose life equal to its toughness.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.
